adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and, for collective team events, `handleNewBooking` pushes additional team members’ destination calendars onto `evt.destinationCalendar` (apps/web + packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts). `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` then iterates destinations and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` per destination/credential. Google’s `createEvent` now selects the calendar by matching `credentialId` (`calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`), but Office365’s `createEvent` always uses the first destination calendar via `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and builds the URL from that externalId. For a non-first collective host, this will attempt to create the event in host2’s account but targeting host1’s calendar externalId, plausibly failing and skipping host2’s calendar event.
